content: Outrider Reign of the Sanguine Lords. Series .  Marius was the leader of Sanguine lord Artemis’s  special forces, he had spent a lifetime in the service of his lord, he had heard the stories of the old world, the civilization before the fall of man but that was not his world, his was the world of war and strife as the vampire Lords battled amongst themselves for power and territory .  He did not see it when his lord thought him to be too powerful, have too much influence over his men and even more he didn’t see it when two of his top soldiers,  executed him, leaving him for dead  in  the derelict city of Baltimore .   He awoke  underground , under the care of a disheveled and foulmouthed doctor only to find himself among the strays those who did not bend to the will of the lords who now ruled this land, instead they hid, removing themselves from the world and instead living underground and populating the cities left  bare. Now  Marius finds himself one of these abandoned, those forgotten except to be killed when happened upon by the soldiers of the lords of earth,  Marius soon leaves the care of these people and instead wanders the land for a time, now that he is no longer of the world of the  Lords  he sees how the rest of humanity is treated and his legend grows as he begins to stand against those he  onced  served. The forgotten (Strays) They hide among the rubble of the old world, they are hunted and killed for sport or captured for slaves while those who serve the lords lead good lives, except for the monthly blood draws and the sacrifice of the hunt .  Marius McLellan Once a great commander, now gone rogue Marius is a tall imposing figure with a full beard and steel grey Eyes, his is caramel complexion with a hint of Asian, he is fast and capable, an expert at unarmed combat and weapons alike, he is a leader of men and has spent his life training in warfare .  NOTES: These are notes on the book that I can add later as I think of things  Marcus finds an old Harley and rides  it ,  this is his horse  He carries the sword of his office, a n ancient Chinese long sword He collects weapons and gear from those he kills  He travels the  land ,  no longer part of a world or having a purpose  Soon he finds himself helping the Strays as rumor of him grows  The lords begin to search , to hunt him down.
